params.owner: Required sender address as an owner.

params.numValues1: Number of values in a first array.
params.numValues2: Number of of values in a second array.
params.numValues3: Number of of values in a third array.
params.numValues4: Number of of values in a fourth array.

changeGovernorCheckProposalId(uint256).details: Changes the governor check proposal Id.

checkAfterExecution(bytes32,bool).details: Guards the multisig call after its execution.

checkTransaction(address,uint256,bytes,u.details: Checks the transaction for authorized arguments.

getTargetSelectorChainId(address,bytes4,.details: Gets the status of a target-selector-chainId combination.

returns.status: True, if the target-selector-chainId combination is authorized.

pause().details: Pauses the guard restoring a full CM functionality.

setBridgeMediatorL1BridgeParams(address[.details: Sets bridge mediator and L2 verifier contracts addresses on L1 and L2 chain Ids.

params.bridgeMediatorL1s: Bridge mediator contract addresses on L1.
params.chainIds: Corresponding L2 chain Ids (original EVM numbers).
params.verifierL2s: Corresponding L2 verifier contract addresses on L1.

setTargetSelectorChainIds(address[],byte.details: Authorizes combinations of targets, selectors and chain Ids.

params.statuses: Authorize if true, and restrict otherwise.

unpause().details: Unpauses the guard restricting the CM functionality back.

devdoc.title: GuardCM - Smart contract for Gnosis Safe community multisig (CM) guard

checkTransaction(address,uint256,bytes,u.notice: Scheduling in timelock is checked against authorized targets and signatures.No self-multisig function calls are allowed.

pause().notice: The timeline is able to pause the guard via the voting.The CM can request pausing the guard is there was a proposal to check if the governance is alive.         If the proposal is defeated (not enough votes or never voted on),         the governance is considered inactive for about a week.

setBridgeMediatorL1BridgeParams(address[.notice: It is the contract owner responsibility to set correct L1 bridge mediator contracts,         corresponding L2 verifier contracts, and supported chain Ids.         Note that it is out of scope of the verification procedure to check if any other chain Id formats,         like Wormhole one, is correctly setup during the bridge call.

setTargetSelectorChainIds(address[],byte.notice: It is the contract owner responsibility to set correct L1 chain Ids where the contract is deployed         and corresponding supported L2-s, if the contract interacts with them.
